message.reasoning_content:
We need to parse facts, extract behavior keywords, map to crimes.

Facts: In 静乐县, 张某某 blocked construction, was stopped by 王某某. 张叫儿子李某某, who saw 张躺在地上, slapped 王某某. Then 王某某指使工人殴打李某某, causing light injury (一级轻伤). So that's intentional injury (故意伤害). Also 王某某 for escaping legal pursuit, found 任某某, instructed 任某某 to make false testimony (伪证) about the assault, promising 1万元 per month. Also 王指使工人王某甲、韩某某去派出所作任某某打伤李某某的伪证, leading to 任某某被拘留. So that's "伪证罪" (making false statements to police) i.e., "伪证罪" (false testimony). Also possibly "组织、指使他人实施故意伤害" (the act of ordering others to assault). But the main crimes: intentional injury (故意伤害) and false testimony (伪证罪). Also maybe "妨害司法公正" but Chinese law: "伪证罪" is under Criminal Law article 307? Actually article 307 is "伪证罪". So we list two crimes: 故意伤害;伪证罪.

Check if any other crimes: "指使工人殴打" could be "组织、领导、参加黑社会性质组织"? No. It's just ordering assault, which is part of intentional injury. So we have two crimes.

Need to output in format: [罪名]故意伤害;伪证罪<eoa>

Make sure no extra spaces. Provide reasoning and final answer in JSON.
